svg.metadata: {"story":"Noah","act":10,"chapter":"Ch.10 · The Vineyard","scene":"C","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"Noah plants a vineyard, drinks the wine, and is uncovered in his tent; Ham sees, Shem and Japheth cover him.
